laws.law: Literal-shaped type-position spellings [T], #mut[T], #set{T}, #map{K:V}, and ${label:T,...} are accepted only as PREVIEW_DESIGN sugar for existing canonical identities and remain nonactivatable. Parser goals, one-based indexing, the current bracket matrix, Union formation, Map/Record domains, and current Prelude signatures are unchanged. Collection ownership is immutable-first with explicit mutable owners; Sequence stays traversal-only. Current FrozenList and ListSnapshot identities remain distinct. Freeze is shallow, failure-atomic, and supplies no shareability proof; snapshot preserves its source and yields an independent point-in-time value; a view is owner-bounded and coordinate/provenance preserving. Semantic P0 is 0, feature P1 remains exactly 22 OPEN, and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

laws.law: Enum declaration-order Eq/Ord derivation, case-owned Display mapping, and payload-free exact-variant subset aliases are Stable design. The order profile uses exactly one of enum#increasing or enum#decreasing, is restricted to payload-free nongeneric Enums, forms one whole-Enum Eq and Ord witness, and keeps SemanticOrderRank separate from VariantId, raw, serialization, layout, ABI, and match priority. The four ordering glyphs and enum ranges consume only SemanticOrderRank; `..` and `..<` advance in semantic Ord order and reverse traversal is explicit through downTo. A case-owned ~> mapping is all-or-none, uses a restricted read-only String template, and forms one whole-Enum Display witness. An enum-associated +type alias uses finite same-owner payload-free VariantId membership, reuses owner representation and witnesses, widens losslessly to its owner, and narrows only through an explicit checked boundary. Existing Enum markers remain unchanged; semantic P0 is 0, feature P1 remains exactly 22 OPEN, and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

laws.law: Named-rest declarations use `name***: Record`; function types use `Record***`; call and materialization named unfold use `**expr`.
Lazy bindings use `let#lazy`.
Sealed classes use `sealed class`; `class#sealed` is removed.
Unit multiplication uses `*`.
The obsolete prefixed collection spelling is entirely absent; ordinary List and NumericArray forms remain.
The package is self-contained; the exact Grammar and Frontend Model are separate canonical artifacts.
The frontend, HIR, MIR and xVM are implemented in Rust; Deeplus MIR is semantic authority; xVM interprets bytecode; LLVM provides AOT and later ORC JIT.
Rightward local binding is ordinary `let` or `var` sugar and leaves no semantic residue.
Raw String is Stable design; R2 and provider derive-via are official tooling contracts.
Source AST quotation and logic-variable surfaces are absent; internal compiler trees remain implementation data.
The accepted bounded sugar families elaborate to existing core forms and retain their active diagnostics.
The dynamic/unsafe quarantine profile is nonactivatable Preview design.
Map dot-key projection, increment/decrement expressions, the tailrec callable kind, regex literals and automatic heterogeneous-List Union inference are absent.

The lexical vocabulary contains 29 hard keywords and 106 contextual words. `auto`, `by`, `conform`, `derives`, and `supports` are contextual owner words for the Stable Trait Conformance surface, while `array` and `case` remain ordinary identifiers.

TC-R001..R016 are Stable current coherence law. The canonical successor surface is `type A conforms Trait`, repeated nominal-header `conforms`, class/Trait `derives`, qualified `Trait::member`, and `conform Trait { ... }`; the former introducer, class colon inheritance, and Trait-inheritance `requires` surfaces are removed. Existing lowercase `via`, `as name`, `<T as Trait>::Item`, and the exact `.`, `+`, `*.`, `*+` witness markers remain unchanged.

TCC-DG-001..008 and TCC-DG-P2-009/A/B remain the current identity, witness, overlap, termination, diagnostic, and evolution guards. `supports auto` and `by auto` are admitted only when a canonical closed synthesis-policy record exists; lowercase `via` keeps its current route and body semantics. Local/runtime conformance, structural fallback, specialization, and child-local parent-witness replacement remain absent.
Class/Enumeration CE-G6 successor law is PREVIEW_DESIGN nonactivatable; current mixed payload and four current Enum markers remain unchanged.

Static-first Dyn/Facet successor law is PREVIEW_DESIGN and nonactivatable; current borrow Facet remains unchanged and product support is not claimed. The exact OPEN P1 set has total 22: Class 6, Enumeration 8, Trait 7, and SFD-P1-009 1; SFD-P1-001..008 are CLOSED_BY_DESIGN_NORMATIVE_STATIC_RATIFICATION_R1. The historical string f509fce5df6c16b77d3acccdcde4c640b093da0a is immutable non-authoritative provenance; the corrected actual historical main is f509fce5df6c16b77d3accdccde4c640b093da0a. The successor relation is CONTROLLING_STATUS_AND_ERRATUM_APPLIED; Git commit SHA and artifact SHA-256 remain separate identity domains.
U-07 is excluded from this adoption tranche pending explicit user selection; no E-02/E-06 migration alternative or automatic rewrite is selected.
All adopted successor rows use PREVIEW_DESIGN, source_activation nonactivatable, implementation NOT_AUTHORIZED, support NOT_CLAIMED, and product lanes 15/15 NOT_RUN.

One Pattern CST/AST is admitted through explicit context policies. A callable parameter begins with one stable channel Identifier and may add only checker-proven irrefutable body-entry structural decomposition; the child binders never change call/API/ABI identity. Plain bindings, bare for, parameters and direct-local Pattern assignment are irrefutable owners; guarded bindings, if/while/for let, ordered catch and match are refutable owners, while let!/var! explicitly raise PatternMatchDefect on mismatch. Current carriers are nominal variants with positional or named payloads, exact fixed-product Tuple, exact/open Record and Map rows, explicitly pattern-transparent nominal products, and closed List-shaped carriers. Record/Map are exact by default and use .._ or ..name for open remainder; entry mapping is destination Pattern : source identity. Pin and bounded range/relational Patterns require stable values and a closed exact equality/order descriptor. List patterns admit exact shape, the existing all-ignored `[.._]`, or exactly one attached positional rest: `leadings..` first, `..tail` last, or `..middle..` between at least one fixed pattern on each side. Generic `Sequence<T>` conformance alone never activates bracket syntax or pattern opening. And/Not, Set, NumericArray, Synonym/View/completeness/find, top-level decomposition, generic Sequence opening and nonlocal/shared assignment remain Preview Gated; effectful/dynamic/backtracking extraction is not admitted.

laws.law: Stable Sequence-rest design is restricted to the closed built-in List-shaped decomposition matrix and exactly one positional rest. A captured rest has exact borrowed type `ListRestView<T>`, retains its source owner, borrow region, ordinal RankSpan, and original logical-coordinate projection, admits `count = 0` without constructing an empty source Range, and has one explicit intrinsic `Sequence<T>` witness. Existing `ReadonlyView<T>` does not acquire a Sequence witness. Final rest publication follows all structural tests and the pure guard; failure publishes no rest and extends no temporary lifetime. Bare `-> T1, T2`, `return`/`ret e1, e2`, and `let`/`var p1, p2 = value` are fixed-product Tuple sugar with one result channel and no general comma operator, ValuePack, Sequence return carrier, ABI identity, or type-dependent lowering. Direct mutable local Plain targets admit bounded parallel Tuple assignment with complete RHS staging, distinct LocalPlaceIds, and one failure-atomic logical group commit. Generic Sequence opening, owner-retaining temporary residuals, affine/resource permutation, and field/index/property/shared/actor/FFI parallel targets remain Preview Gated. Product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN, and this design-static adoption closes no existing P1.

array and case are ordinary identifiers. Positional unfold consumes Sequence or statically known tuple evidence, never NumericArray flattening. Result applications preserve the error role, conditions are Bool, and try/@try require a catch or finally owner.
laws.source_evidence: Design Handoff Array/Case Identifier Type Clarification R1 and user canonicalization direction

laws.law: Functions, methods, local functions, closures, and lambdas preserve value/context/witness/rest channels together with ownership, capture, cleanup, effects, errors, cancellation, suspension, isolation, call-right, and lifetime. Phase-A generic inference is argument-driven, requires one unique normalized substitution, and uses an expected result only to verify an already solved substitution. Call admission resolves one declaration identity without return-type-directed overload selection and then checks positional, labeled, repeated, named-unfold, context, and using-evidence channels independently. An ordinary mut parameter is a callee-owned mutable local and is distinct from caller-place inout. Closure borrow/inout/move/copy/clone/deep/once captures have explicit acquisition, escape, witness, cleanup, and callable-multiplicity boundaries. Public parameter decomposition is explicit in the body; return and local ret keep distinct owners.
laws.source_evidence: cross-domain language coherence review and user canonicalization direction

laws.law: Actors own isolated state and a mailbox with one mutating turn at a time. An omitted MailboxClause selects logical_unbounded_v1; #mailbox(capacity: N) selects bounded_reject_v1 and immediately returns ActorMessageError::mailboxFull when full. One-way message expressions have exact type Result<Unit, error ActorMessageError>; requests have exact immediate type Result<Task<T>, error ActorMessageError> and the Task is extracted before await. Only a successfully admitted actor-request Task<T> carries the non-forgeable typed-HIR/module-API/MIR TaskResponsibility descriptor, so its normalized result type, handler ErrorSet, cancellation axis, isolation owner, request correlation identity, and receiverClosedBeforeReply terminal failure remain preserved without introducing a second visible Task type parameter; an ordinary async Task<T> carries no actor transport descriptor. Rejection before enqueue commit retains moved owners and allocates no channel_sequence; commit transfers each owner exactly once and allocates a strictly increasing sequence in the exact sender/receiver/mailbox-profile FIFO key. Cancellation remains distinct before and after commit, request/reply remains correlated and single-terminal, tasks remain structurally scoped, and product execution remains NOT_RUN.
laws.source_evidence: Issue #28 cross-role audit, spec/contracts/actor-concurrency-coherence.json, and user canonicalization direction

laws.law: Deeplus values keep semantic identity separate from storage, serialization, discriminant, ABI, and backend layout. Int is the checked signed 64-bit default, and absence uses ::none in an expected Option context or Option<T>::none explicitly. The current operator vocabulary, fixity, binding power, and associativity are closed. Arbitrary custom operators are not part of the language. Fixed existing-glyph conformance dispatch is Stable for exactly thirteen unary, binary-arithmetic, equality, and total-order roles through nine Prelude Trait roots under intrinsic reservation plus one left-owner DIRECT_GLOBAL conformance with no conversion, order ranking, fallback, or runtime relookup. Derived inequality, ordering projections, and compound assignment create no independent witness; range remains a closed intrinsic carrier rule rather than a conformance hook. Stable ternary evaluates one Bool condition and exactly one lazy arm and joins type, ownership, effect, error, cancellation, place, and cleanup responsibility without synthesizing a Union. Map literals evaluate direct entries and Map unfolds once from left to right, replace duplicate keys deterministically inside one failure-atomic plan, and publish no partial Map. Basic String interpolation preselects deterministic synchronous Display witnesses, evaluates holes once in source order, and grants no hidden locale, provider, serialization, parsing, or redaction authority; colon format-spec semantics remain DEFERRED_PRODUCT_HANDOFF. Attached NumericArray transpose is a semantic nonowning, owner-bounded read-only coordinate view with no implicit element copy, language-observable allocation authority, mutation, adjoint, or isolation crossing; backend representation remains unselected. Built-in ordered sequences and default NumericArray axes are one-based, bounded lists preserve declared coordinates, slices preserve coordinates and owner provenance, and [] is activated only by the closed built-in carrier matrix.

Flow facts live in Phi and never mutate declared types. Exact typed alternatives are refutable inside closed Union pattern owners; the existing closed-Union-only `is`/`!is` forms evaluate the subject and stored injection identity once and produce complementary Bool edge facts. `T where > rhs` is exact sugar for `T where this > rhs`, while `T in a..b` and `T in a..<b` are inclusive and upper-exclusive interval refinements; bare `T > rhs` is not a type surface. A monotone chained binder Pattern such as `0 <= value <= 100` binds the match subject once and exposes the corresponding refinement fact in its arm; mixed direction rejects. Every admitted def#guard exports one verified finite-R0 GuardSummaryV1. A direct exact call over stable actual places may substitute that summary once and add P/not(P) to the true/false Phi edges without changing declared types, producing a proof object, or reevaluating the predicate. Stored Bool values, wrappers, dynamic dispatch, unstable actuals, and guarded-arm exhaustiveness gain no fact. Durable facts die on assignment, aliasing mutation, exclusive borrow, escape/capture, consume, suspension, or a may-mutate/may-consume call. Float complements remain logical negation and are not algebraically strengthened across NaN. Union formation requires a finite pairwise DISJOINT proof, and pattern probes commit ownership only after structural success and a true admitted guard. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

Exactly ClassDecl, TraitDecl, EnumDecl, TypeAliasDecl, SchemaDecl, ActorDecl, ActorProtocolDecl, TypestateResourceDecl, and BitfieldDecl are type-producing top-level visibility owners. In every Stable or Preview library, executable, and script root they require an explicit public/common/private domain; omission is rejected and produces zero admitted HIR type identities. Every other top-level owner carrying TopLevelVisibility? defaults an omitted word to private. Wider API residue cannot expose a narrower identity, common is never external or re-exported, and public requires a separately admitted export or module interface.
Superseded payload-aggregate message-call design retained as immutable decision history. The controlling current call design is DSGN-CURRENT-UNIFIED-CALL-ACTOR-TRANSPORT.

Ordinary, message ~, and actor-transport :~ calls normalize to one CallExpr with a discriminating CallMode and one ordered CallArgument family. All three modes share positional, named, unfold, context, witness, and trailing-closure binding judgments. Structured ~ and :~ are Pratt led parselets at rank 15; ~ is left-associative and :~ is terminal and nonassociative. A comma after a nested tilde call requires explicit grouping. There is no message payload aggregate or Tuple/Record-to-formal projection. :~ statically selects one actor on/request operation with no ordinary fallback, performs immediate failure-atomic mailbox admission, and never implicitly suspends or retries. on and request with the same selector and canonical call shape are rejected early, and actor transport is forbidden in defer. Semantic P0 remains 0, the existing feature P1 set remains exactly 22 OPEN, and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

laws.law: array and case are ordinary IDENTIFIER spellings and occur in no keyword or sigil-role vocabulary. Stable raw String uses the attached #raw"..." surface and preserves exact body scalars without escape or interpolation. QualifiedPath contains one or more identifier segments joined by ::. Learner-facing material teaches this positive path model without repeatedly foregrounding invalid punctuation, while exact diagnostics and negative fixtures remain available when an error occurs. Package is the distribution, dependency, build, artifact, and provenance unit; Module is the namespace, visibility, name-resolution, and source-composition unit. ModuleId combines PackageId and ModulePath, and filesystem layout is not language identity. Semantic P0 remains 0, the existing feature P1 set remains exactly 22 OPEN, and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.
laws.source_evidence: User vocabulary, raw String, qualified-path, and package/module coherence direction

laws.law: Arbitrary glyph/fixity/precedence custom operators are not a Deeplus feature. Fixed-glyph conformance overloading is STABLE_DESIGN for exactly unary +/-, binary +,-,*,/,%, equality ==/!=, and ordering </<=/>/>=. The Prelude roots are UnaryPlus, UnaryMinus, Add<Rhs>, Subtract<Rhs>, Multiply<Rhs>, Divide<Rhs>, Remainder<Rhs>, Eq<Rhs>, and Ord<Rhs>; != is derived from Eq and the four ordering glyphs from one Ord.compare result. Compound +=,-=,*=,/=,%= is derived from the corresponding binary operation and exact assignment admission and creates no independent witness. Every non-intrinsic expression uses at most one direct-global left-owner conformance with intrinsic reservation and no conversion, source order, fallback, specialization, alternate route, or runtime relookup. Division and remainder faults raise ArithmeticDefect before commit. The Stable &&/||/^^/~~ family remains closed built-in pointwise logical behavior and supplies no user-carrier hook. Stable `static { ... }` retains its exact function-body prologue contract. The accepted Trait shared-design surface uses type/conforms, repeated conforms, derives, supports auto/by auto under a closed policy, qualified Trait::member, and conform blocks while preserving lowercase via, as-name identity, and associated projections. Semantic P0 remains 0 and the existing feature P1 set remains exactly 22 OPEN; every product lane remains NOT_RUN.
laws.source_evidence: Design_Deeplus_Trait_Conformance_Shared_Design_Report_R1(8).md; explicit user fixed-glyph expansion and refinement direction; decisions/language/Design_Deeplus_Trait_Operator_Refinement_Adoption_R1.md

laws.law: Rational is an always-available exact stdlib-backed value over a normalized BigInt pair and <p/q> is its expression-prefix transactional literal. Complex admits exactly Float32/Float64 Rep, bare Complex normalizes to Complex<Float64>, and attached floating 3.0 + 4.0i is canonical. Float is a closed alias of Float64. UInt is the distinct default unsigned semantic domain 0..2^64-1, not an alias of UInt64 and not eligible for the negative literal adapter. Rational supplies the Stable +,-,*,/,%,Eq,Ord profile; a zero divisor raises ArithmeticDefect before commit, while named dividedBy remains the recoverable checked API. Complex supplies its closed arithmetic and existing equality profile but never Ord. Scalar real/Complex ^ remains a closed static intrinsic. The type-directed std::math elementary facade is a bounded STDLIB_PROFILE. Integer-magnitude 4i and std::math special/calculus families remain PREVIEW_DESIGN. Static capability lookup and the verified HIR-H1 boundary remain as previously adopted; MIR-X1 implementation, backend switch and every product lane remain nonactivatable or NOT_RUN. Semantic P0 remains 0 and the exact existing feature P1 set remains 22 OPEN.
laws.source_evidence: Five attached companion, Complex/Rational and exponentiation authority proposals; explicit user i-literal/HIR-H1/canonicalization direction; bounded multi-role reconciliation

laws.law: A no-capture-clause synchronous callable may read an ancestor local or parameter as an invocation-time lexical dependency only when same-isolation region-bounded residence, read-only nonconsuming access, rooted-borrow nonescape, and LiveReadable call-site state are proven. Residence and explicit environment capture are orthogonal HIR axes, and lexical reads create no CapturePlan item or observable MIR event. Present empty [] is a closed ancestor-frame assertion. Existing [name] remains an explicit-capture compatibility surface. Mutation, move/consume, snapshot, escape, suspension, guard, async, generator, task, actor, FFI and unknown proof remain explicit or rejected. Product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

The successor rule that omitted throws normalizes to Never and omitted effects normalizes to {}, with implementation-body rows subset-checked against the declaration, is PREVIEW_DESIGN_NONACTIVATABLE. CST presence is not typed identity; HIR/API/MIR carry complete normalized rows. Trait witness narrowing, exact override compatibility and function-value row subsumption remain distinct. Current private_error_set_inference is unchanged; Stable promotion requires deterministic source migration and explicit supersession. Product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

Current Stable function-static activation uses contextual `static { ... }`. Persistent immutable function-static slots are a separate PREVIEW_DESIGN_NONACTIVATABLE profile using proposed static#slot declarations and static#slot:: references that do not collide with Stable let:: or QualifiedStaticExpr grammar, a fifth closed FUNCTION_STATIC_NAMESPACE domain, deeply immutable M0 values, declaration-order prior-slot staging, atomic Ready publication, and existing activation failure/reentry identities. Current OPEN P1 remains exactly 22 and product lanes remain 15/15 NOT_RUN.

authority_policy: USER_DIRECT records current user direction and receives strong presumptive weight, but remains reviewable against contradictions and evidence; no decision row is immutable constitutional law. Explicit decisions adopted for this release control its projections until revised. DESIGNER_ACCEPTED decisions are reviewable; DERIVED_PROJECTION rows have no independent authority.
